events.title: 노팅엄 포리스트 achieve a record Premier League away win when they beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 7–1 at Hillsborough . Meanwhile, 입스위치 타운 and 레스터 시티's survival hopes are virtually ended by home defeats. 아스널 climb four places up the Premier League table with a 5–1 home win over 노리치 시티. 크리스털 팰리스 climb out of the relegation zone with a 2–1 home win over 맨체스터 시티, who are now just four points above the relegation zone having been in the hunt for a UEFA Cup place as recently as December.

리버풀 beat Bolton to win the League Cup for a record fifth time with two goals from Man of the Match , Steve McManaman. A thrilling game at The Dell sees 사우샘프턴 move closer to safety with a 4–3 win over 토트넘 홋스퍼, with 맷 르티시에 scoring twice for the hosts and 테디 셰링엄 scoring twice for the visitors. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a goalless draw at home to Leeds, with 블랙번 로버스 potentially on the verge of going eight points ahead at the top of the Premier League, and 알렉스 퍼거슨 admitting that the chances of his team winning a third successive league title are now slim.

Howard Kendall is sacked as 노츠 카운티 manager. While results briefly improved following his appointment, it is clear by now that the club have no hope of avoiding relegation. Previous caretaker Russell Slade is also dismissed, and veteran player Steve Nicol, who was signed by Kendall shortly into his brief reign, is handed control of the team for the remainder of the season.
블랙번 로버스 go eight points ahead at the top of the Premier League with six games left, winning 1–0 at QPR.

On-loan Ghanaian striker 토니 예보아 scores a hat-trick for 리즈 유나이티드 in a 4–0 home win over 입스위치 타운 – a result which relegates the visitors. 레스터 시티 cling onto their Premier League status with a 1–0 home win over a 노리치 시티 who are heading towards the relegation zone just three months after being in close contention for a UEFA Cup place.

It is announced that 에리크 캉토나's community service order will take place in the form of coaching football to young boys in the Manchester area. 아스널 beat 삼프도리아 3–2 in the semi-finals of the European Cup Winners' Cup , but the chances of an all-English final are left looking extremely slim after 첼시 are beaten 3–0 by 레알 사라고사 in Spain .

노리치 시티 fall closer to the relegation zone in a 3–0 defeat at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 레스터 시티's relegation is confirmed by a 1–0 defeat at 셰필드 웬즈데이. 체스터 시티 become the first Football League side to be relegated this season, due to their failure to defeat 브리스틀 로버스 .

35-year-old 크리스털 팰리스 supporter Paul Nixon is crushed to death by a coach outside a 월솔 public house before the FA Cup semi-final at Villa Park between 크리스털 팰리스 and 맨체스터 유나이티드. Mr Nixon had been trying to escape a brawl between supporters of the two teams, after being stabbed and seriously injured by a brick. The semi-final ended in a 2–2 draw after extra time, while 에버턴 overcome 토트넘 홋스퍼 4–1 in the other semi-final. In the Premier League, Leeds keep their European hopes alive with a 1–0 away win over 리버풀.

Derek Mann resigns as 체스터 시티 manager after failing to save the club from relegation, and reverts to his previous role as club physio. 에버턴 veteran Kevin Ratcliffe takes over as player-manager of the club, who are now looking almost certain to finish bottom of Division Two.

맨체스터 유나이티드 reach the FA Cup final after beating 크리스털 팰리스 2–0 in the semi-final replay which was attended by fewer than 18,000 fans. United had Roy Keane sent off, with his availability for the remaining season being put into further doubt by an ankle injury picked up minutes before he was dismissed. The losing side also had Darren Pitcher and Darren Patterson sent off. 리버풀 move closer to securing a UEFA Cup place with a 1–0 win at 아스널, as do 노팅엄 포리스트 with a 1–0 win at 노리치 시티. 사우샘프턴 move closer to survival with a 2–0 win at 첼시.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 climb out of the bottom four win a 3–0 home win over 윔블던.
에버턴's 2–0 home win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 confirms relegation for 레스터 시티 and 입스위치 타운, while 맨체스터 시티 boost their survival bid and surge to 11th with a 2–1 home win over 리버풀.

이언 라이트 keeps up his strong record of goals against 입스위치 타운 by scoring in a 4–1 league win for 아스널 at Highbury. 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep their title hopes alive with a 4–0 win at relegated 레스터 시티, while 사우샘프턴 continue their surge up the table with a 2–1 home win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스. 블랙번 로버스 drop points when Leeds hold them to a 1–1 draw at Ewood Park.

맨체스터 유나이티드's title bid is made harder when 첼시 hold them to a goalless draw at Old Trafford. However, their neighbour's City do them a favour by beating leaders 블랙번 로버스 3–2 at Ewood Park, a result which boosts their own battle against relegation. The gap between first and second now stands at five points with four games left to play. 아스널 managed another impressive victory, beating 애스턴 빌라 4–0 at Villa Park . 사우샘프턴 take a big step towards safety with a 2–0 win at 윔블던.

New 레이턴 오리엔트 owner Barry Hearn dismisses co-managers John Sitton and Chris Turner , and replaces them with 토트넘 홋스퍼 coach Pat Holland . 아스널 reach their second successive European Cup Winners' Cup final by defeating 삼프도리아 on penalties after losing the return leg 3–2 in Italy , but 첼시's fightback at home to 레알 사라고사 in the other semi-final second leg isn't quite enough and they bow out by a single goal after an eventful first European campaign in more than 20 years. 블랙번 로버스 move closer to title glory with a 2–1 home win over 크리스털 팰리스, who remain in the relegation zone as a result.

Bolton miss the chance to go top of Division One when they lose 2–0 at Reading , whose chances of securing the only automatic promotion spot in the division this season are boosted as a result. Tranmere blow a similar opportunity with a 2–0 defeat at home to Southend, who are enjoying a resurgence in form.

The day after being confirmed as Football Conference champions, 매클즈필드 타운's celebrations are dashed in devastating fashion when the Football League announces that they will not be promoted into Division Three due to their Moss Rose ground not meeting safety requirements. While 체스터 시티 and 크루 알렉산드라 both offer the use of their respective Deva Stadium and Gresty Road grounds, the League refuse to waive their rule that new clubs must own their own ground (introduced to avoid a repeat of the situation which led to the demise of Maidstone United three years prior). This announcement also means that Scarborough and 엑서터 시티 , who had been battling to avoid bottom spot (with 노샘프턴 타운 also having been not entirely out of danger), are guaranteed safety regardless of where they finish. In the Autoglass Trophy final, a Wembley match is decided by a golden goal for the first time when a 103rd-minute goal from Paul Tait gives 버밍엄 시티 a 1–0 win over 칼라일 유나이티드 . Barry Fry 's team are also hoping to add the Division Two title – and with it an immediate return to Division One – to their first notable honour since they won the Football League Cup in 1963.
에리크 캉토나 ends weeks of speculation about a move to 인테르 by signing a new three-year contract with 맨체스터 유나이티드.
Roy McFarland is sacked after 18 months as manager of 더비 카운티 after failing to qualify for the Division One playoffs.

미들즈브러 clinch the Division One championship – and the only automatic promotion place to the Premier League for this season – by beating 루턴 타운 2–1 in the final game at 93-year-old Ayresome Park and at the end of 브라이언 롭슨's first season in management. They move into their new 30,000-seat stadium this summer, which will be the first new stadium occupied by a top flight club since 맨체스터 시티 moved to Maine Road in 1923. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 beat 블랙번 로버스 2–0 at Upton Park, when victory for the visitors would have taken them to within two points of winning the Premier League title.
